description: Bay Area major-event leads (e.g. from 小紅書 / parent blogs / agent web search). Add rows here; run npm run discover:regional-weekly to queue them in Admin Discovery for review. Every lead MUST have an official eventUrl for fact-check — not the XHS post URL.

leads.title: Kings Mountain Art Fair
leads.description: Walk the redwoods & browse juried art — Kiddie Hollow has supervised spin art, sand art & a toddler-friendly craft table.
leads.tips: Labor Day weekend Sep 5–7, booths 10am–5pm. Free admission & shuttle from marked Skyline stops (per official site). Kiddie Hollow $5 supply fee, 10am–4pm. No pets.
leads.leadNotes: Web search — Labor Day regional roundup; Kiddie Hollow on official site · Do not add — weak toddler seasonal fit; out of core cities.
leads.disposition: Do not add — weak toddler seasonal fit; out of core cities.

leads.title: Scottish Highland Gathering & Games
leads.description: Sheepdog trials, birds of prey, Celtic animals & living history — plus Passport to the Clans for kids to explore the grounds.
leads.tips: Sep 5–6; gates 8am, admission closes 4:30pm. Tickets online only (QR at gate). Free tickets for ages 5 & under per official FAQ. No dogs except service animals.
leads.leadNotes: Web search — 160th annual Labor Day weekend; family activities on FAQ · Do not add — weak toddler seasonal fit; out of core cities.
leads.disposition: Do not add — weak toddler seasonal fit; out of core cities.

leads.title: Garlic City Car Show & Harvest Festival
leads.description: Classic cars plus a family harvest zone — petting zoo, pumpkin activities & slot-car track (first 300 families get a pumpkin ticket per official page).
leads.tips: Sat Sep 19, 2:30–6:30pm. Adults $10 online; under 18 free; parking free. Gilroy Gardens Premium Members admitted without separate ticket (per gilroy.org).
leads.leadNotes: Web search — Gilroy fall harvest; kid activities on official event page · Do not add — Garlic City Car Show; weak toddler seasonal fit.
leads.disposition: Do not add — Garlic City Car Show; weak toddler seasonal fit.

leads.title: Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch
leads.description: Hayrides, pony rides, petting zoo & two hay mazes — West Marin farm outing with no admission or parking fee.
leads.tips: Opens Sep 25 daily through Oct 31 (hours on official site). Weekend extras from Sep 26 include live kids music & farm animals. Check nicasiovalleypumpkinpatch.net for activity dates.
leads.leadNotes: Web search — Marin/North Bay pumpkin season opener · Queue later — Seasonal / Worth a drive closer to opening; not Fall featured yet.
leads.disposition: Queue later — Seasonal / Worth a drive closer to opening; not Fall featured yet.

leads.title: The Great Big BOO! at Gilroy Gardens
leads.description: Family-friendly Halloween at the theme park — BOO Trail trick-or-treat stations, costumes welcome & seasonal shows.
leads.tips: Fri–Sun Sep 25–Oct 31 (park closed to public Sat Oct 10 per official page). Park admission required. Not-too-spooky — masks covering full face not allowed.
leads.leadNotes: Web search — South Bay fall theme-park event · Hold for Halloween with little ones — never Fall Pick; Seasonal drive only.
leads.disposition: Hold for Halloween with little ones — never Fall Pick; Seasonal drive only.

leads.title: Half Moon Bay Art & Pumpkin Festival
leads.address: Main Street, Half Moon Bay, CA 94019
leads.description: Coastside pumpkin festival on Main Street — Great Pumpkin Parade, costume contest & pumpkin carving for little ones.
leads.tips: Oct 17–18, 9am–5pm; free admission. Kids Fun Run Sun Oct 18 (separate registration on official schedule). Weigh-Off Mon Oct 12 is a separate event. No pets.
